$comment: KL-4201 cement rotary kiln twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the kiln data sheet, the design heat balance and textbook heat transfer; the device sends only what it measures.

identification.model: in-line calciner and grate cooler (5000 t/d)
identification.description: Clinker line rotary kiln, 4.8 m x 74 m on three tyres, 5-stage preheater with calciner, grate cooler
identification.kiln: Rotary kiln 4.8 m x 74 m, three tyres (floating tyres on shell pads), girth gear drive, graphite inlet and outlet seals
identification.reference: Dimensions inside the published range of three-base kilns (Fuller, formerly FLSmidth Cement: 3.6 to 6.6 m diameter, 55 to 104 m long); typical proportions, not a vendor model
identification.preheater: 5-stage cyclone preheater, in-line calciner with tertiary air duct
identification.instruments: Shell scanner (line-scan infrared), burning zone pyrometer, kiln inlet / calciner / preheater exit gas analysers, tyre migration and shell ovality sensors, stack CEMS

kiln.source: Diameter and length: assumption: typical value, replace with your kiln supplier's data sheet / performance test (inside the 3.6 to 6.6 m x 55 to 104 m range of Fuller three-base kilns). Speed 4.0 rpm and slope 3.5 % (2 degrees): inside 30 to 250 rev/h and 1 to 4 degrees (Wikipedia, Cement kiln); assumption: typical value, replace with your kiln supplier's data sheet / performance test

heat_balance.source: Theoretical heat of clinker formation 1720 kJ/kg (cementkilns.co.uk example clinker: 1719 kJ/kg). BAT range 2900 to 3300 MJ/t (2013/163/EU, BAT 6). Preheater exit gas volume and temperature, cooler exhaust air volume and temperature, mean heat capacities of the gases and of clinker, clinker temperature leaving the kiln and the cooler, cooler wall loss and the remaining losses (raw meal moisture, dust, preheater walls, unburnt fuel): assumption: typical value, replace with your kiln supplier's data sheet / performance test. Design specific heat consumption is the sum of the balance: 3006 kJ/kg. Fuel: coal / petcoke blend, LHV 26 MJ/kg, 60 % to the calciner: assumption: typical value, replace with your kiln supplier's data sheet / performance test

shell.source: Shell heat loss = area x [emissivity x Stefan-Boltzmann x (Ts^4 - Ta^4) + h x (Ts - Ta)] (textbook). Painted-steel emissivity 0.9, convection coefficient 12 W/m2K (light wind), mean and burning-zone shell temperatures with coating, 220 mm magnesia-spinel lining in the burning zone with conductivity 2.8 W/m K and a 1400 C hot face: assumption: typical value, replace with your kiln supplier's data sheet / performance test. Equivalent lining thickness = k x (T_hot - Ts) / q(Ts): one-dimensional conduction through brick + coating.

burning_zone.source: Burning zone material temperature about 1450 C (Wikipedia, Cement kiln: sintering zone charge around 1450 C; thermal NOx directly related to the flame temperature). Kiln inlet NOx at design, its sensitivity (NOx x e^(k x dT), k = 0.010 per K, about double per 70 K) and the design free lime: assumption: typical value, replace with your kiln supplier's data sheet / performance test

gas.source: Kiln inlet and calciner outlet O2, false air across the preheater (from O2 rise: (O2_exit - O2_calc) / (21 - O2_exit)): assumption: typical value, replace with your kiln supplier's data sheet / performance test

drive.source: Main drive torque at design load (percent of rated) and of the empty kiln (friction of rollers and seals, even coating), rated motor power at maximum speed: assumption: typical value, replace with your kiln supplier's data sheet / performance test. Bed hold-up and its torque scale with output / speed.

tyres.source: Migration per revolution = pi x hot gap; hot gap = cold gap - alpha x D x (T_shell under the tyre - T_tyre); steel expansion 1.2e-5 per K (textbook). Cold gap, design temperatures, tyre 1 and 3 migration and the ovality-to-gap line: assumption: typical value, replace with your kiln supplier's data sheet / performance test

cooler.source: Secondary air temperature: assumption: typical value, replace with your kiln supplier's data sheet / performance test

stack.source: Stack NOx after SNCR at 10 % O2 and stack O2: assumption: typical value, replace with your kiln supplier's data sheet / performance test. Reference O2 10 % for cement kilns (2013/163/EU; 2010/75/EU Annex VI).

demo.note: Demo only: the plant clock runs 60 times faster; output swings 3 % over 15 min and the kiln speed follows it.

points.label: Clinker output (kiln feed x clinker factor)
Position of the hottest point from the outlet
Stack NOx as NO2, dry, as measured

limits.source: Shell hot spot 400 C and minimum equivalent lining 100 mm (refractory supplier and plant practice), torque, O2, false air, cooler efficiency, heat consumption, free lime, NOx and migration limits: assumption: typical value, replace with your kiln supplier's data sheet / performance test. Ovality D/10 % (rule of thumb). Stack NOx 450 mg/Nm3: the upper end of the BAT-AEL range used as the permit limit (assumption: use your own permit; the legal check is on the daily average).

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

refractory_loss.name: Coating loss / lining wear in the burning zone
refractory_loss.symptoms: a hot spot on the shell scanner, equivalent lining thickness falls

ring_formation.name: Ring build-up in the transition zone
ring_formation.symptoms: drive torque above the load, kiln inlet O2 falls, CO rises

false_air.name: False air into the preheater (worn flaps, open doors, seals)
false_air.symptoms: O2 rises from calciner outlet to preheater exit, more gas through the ID fan

cooler_degradation.name: Grate cooler recuperation loss (red river, worn plates)
cooler_degradation.symptoms: hotter clinker and exhaust air, cooler efficiency and heat consumption worse

tyre_pad_wear.name: Tyre pad / filler bar wear at tyre 2
tyre_pad_wear.symptoms: gap and migration grow, shell ovality grows (lining loosens)

burning_zone_cold.name: Burning zone too cold (raw mix or flame change)
burning_zone_cold.symptoms: pyrometer and NOx fall together, free lime rises

pyrometer_fouling.name: Burning zone pyrometer fouled or misaligned
pyrometer_fouling.symptoms: pyrometer falls, NOx and free lime do not follow

fuel_meter_drift.name: Calciner coal feeder reads low
fuel_meter_drift.symptoms: heat consumption from the fuel no longer matches the heat balance
